name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet together and hold a dumbbell at each side.
Step wide to one side with toes pointing mostly forward.
Sit your hips back over the stepping foot, bending that knee while keeping the trailing leg straight.
Drive off the bent leg to return to standing and alternate sides.
tips: Keep the heel of the stepping foot planted flat on the floor.
Keep your chest lifted and frame the stepping knee cleanly with the dumbbells.
